title: Bourse d’Aurelle closes at record high as energy exports lift earnings
content: The Indice d’Aurelle closed at a record **12,486 points** on Wednesday, up 1.4 per cent, as four of the country’s largest energy exporters reported third-quarter earnings above expectations and announced new supply contracts with neighbouring states.

The gains were concentrated in hydroelectric and solar generation, where revenues rose 19 per cent year on year, and in the engineering firms that build transmission infrastructure. The *cotation* of the two largest groups has doubled since 2023, and together they now account for 21 per cent of the index.

Analysts welcomed the results but warned about concentration. “Five firms now represent 38 per cent of the index; a single political decision on export tariffs could move the whole market,” said a strategist at a brokerage in Aurelle. The index’s rise coincided with a day of institutional turmoil, a divergence one analyst described as “a market pricing the economy and ignoring the state”.

The contrast with the financial sector was marked. Bank shares fell for a second session amid the inquiry into the Fonds souverain, and the two largest lenders each lost more than 1.5 per cent before recovering. Yields on ten-year dette souveraine eased six basis points after the Banque des Républiques signalled that it would not accelerate tightening.

Retail participation continues to grow: the Bourse reported a record 41,000 new accounts opened in September, with more than half of them funded through mobile applications. Regulators have repeatedly warned about leveraged products, and the financial markets authority is preparing new disclosure requirements for platforms.

The government has not commented on the record. The opposition notes that the gains are concentrated in regions where the state holds direct stakes, and argues that the proceeds should be used to stabilise the budget rather than distributed as dividends. The next corporate reporting season opens in January.
author: Agence Continentale — bureau de la Bourse d’Aurelle
